narrative: Material PL1__MD4507A6 exhibits erratic working-day demand (CV=0.54) with 79% non-zero days, suggesting irregular but recurring consumption. Lead times average 4.3 working days with moderate variability (CV_LT=0.34); one extreme outlier (9327 days) was removed as a clear data-entry error. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy is recommended: reorder point 2217 units, order quantity 1702 units, providing ≥95% service level while respecting the 2071-unit storage cap.

research_insights.selection_rationale: The (r,Q) policy is appropriate because demand is continuous with moderate intermittency and lead times are relatively stable. EOQ minimises annual holding and ordering costs, and a fixed reorder point with z-score safety stock guarantees the target service level without Monte Carlo simulation.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap (2071 units) constrains the order quantity from unconstrained 1855 to 1702. At peak inflow (SS=369 + OQ=1702=2071), utilisation is 100.0% of capacity. Reduced OQ increases order frequency and ordering costs by ~9%; service level risk is low if replenishment is triggered accurately at ROP=2217.
